answer: An engraver's copper plate etching keeps Sybils out. A newcomer etches 18 plates over 26 days. Each plate is proofed by 2 engravers from other workshops and logged in the plate register, a signal no fake can forge quietly. One plate with more than 3 flawed lines voids its credit and freezes rewards 14 days, and 3 flawed plates void the register. Faking 1,000 agents means etching 18,000 plates and passing 36,000 proofings, 36,000 engraver-days at $5 a plate, about $90,000, before one reward. Like a river carving its horizon line grain by grain, standing is earned plate by plate.
